title: Global Fracture, 1 July 2026
design_rationale: The approved opening window is summer or fall 2026, and 1 July is the earliest clean summer month boundary.

The June United States and Iran memorandum has paused one phase of conflict without removing the possibility of renewed war, preserving coercion, diplomacy, force protection, shipping, and escalation choices.
Justice Mission 2025 is recent history while the later July Taiwan Strait live fire event remains outside the initial state, creating a useful historical reference without forcing it to recur.
The Ukraine war, the Gaza and Levant crisis, Sudan, Myanmar, and the transformed Venezuelan political order keep the rest of the world strategically active.
A clean UTC boundary gives every country, inventory, deployment, market, alliance, sanction, and faction record one reconciliation time.

opening_conditions.summary: A June memorandum between the United States and Iran has announced a cessation of hostilities and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, but verification, implementation, force posture, and political durability remain unresolved.

The interstate war remains active after a winter campaign that heavily degraded energy generation, transmission, distribution, and heating while civilian casualties and long range attacks continued through June.
A ceasefire framework exists, but military activity, lethal incidents, expanding access restrictions, displacement, constrained humanitarian access, and severely damaged essential systems continue.

opening_conditions.region: Taiwan Strait and South China Sea
opening_conditions.summary: Justice Mission 2025 has ended as an announced exercise, but its blockade and joint strike concepts remain recent operational evidence within a continuing campaign of military, political, economic, cyber, and cognitive pressure.

The January United States operation and apprehension of Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores have transformed Venezuela's leadership, sovereignty, military posture, oil governance, and regional alignment questions.
Violence continues across Sudan with escalating regional and humanitarian consequences; force control, external support, and territorial state require theater level reconstruction.
Armed conflict and institutional fragmentation continue while a fuel crisis linked to wider Middle East disruption compounds mobility, services, livelihoods, and humanitarian capacity.

historical_trajectory_references.summary: A later United States account says Iran attacked neutral flagged shipping on 6 and 7 July and United States strikes began on 7 July. This is a historical comparison path, not a scripted certainty.
Taiwan reported newly announced live fire activity in the western Taiwan Strait on 23 and 24 July. This is a historical comparison path, not a scripted certainty.

notes: This file freezes time, not completeness. Every opening condition remains subject to source triangulation and detailed country and theater reconstruction.
